keyWitnesses.name: copy.contextFiltered
keyWitnesses.reason: the build context carries no host state and no install-affecting config, so nothing can pass for a dependency the container should have installed; the ONLY packed output it carries is dist/mpd-package, which is the subject of the pack assertions

keyWitnesses.name: install.exit
keyWitnesses.reason: one command installed the bundle into the profile

keyWitnesses.name: pack.staticCoherence
keyWitnesses.reason: the artifact agrees with the tree it was cut from: 683 carried file(s) byte-identical, 2 generated path(s) exempted (package.json, packages/mpd-ext-plugin/dist/validator.js), none missing

keyWitnesses.name: pack.distFreshRebuild
keyWitnesses.reason: every one of the 35 built entries in the artifact is byte-identical to the container's own from-source rebuild — the packed dist is FRESH, not merely present

keyWitnesses.name: pack.distFreshRebuildControl
keyWitnesses.reason: the freshness arm is FALSIFIABLE on this machine: mutating one built entry in a copy of the same artifact flips pack.distFreshRebuild to FALSE against the SAME from-source rebuild, so a green on the untouched artifact is a measurement rather than a constant (the control's own rows are in /out/owed/pack-control.ndjson)

keyWitnesses.name: boot.presetMount
keyWitnesses.reason: the gateway created a session with agentPreset=mpd — every row of the mpd preset activated (it refuses on an inactive row)

keyWitnesses.name: boot.sessionGateListener
keyWitnesses.reason: the mpd session gate listener is REGISTERED for the created session — witnessed in the row's OWN file log <workspace>/.mpd/logs/mpd-roles.log (R5), liveness not composition (the contract that was silently dead in v0.10.0)

keyWitnesses.name: boot.mcpLiveSearch
